articles.title: Fire at shantytown in southern Seoul extinguished after nearly 13 hours; 1 injured
articles.description: A fire that broke out at a shantytown in Seoul's southern Gangnam district was fully extinguished early Wednesday, nearly 13 hours after it started, authorities said. Firefighters completely put out the blaze at Guryong Village at 4:39 a.m., after containing the main fire late Tuesday.
